Xi Jinping Visits Egypt to Boost Ties and Challenge US Influence

Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Egypt with the stated aim of challenging American influence in West Asia and strengthening bilateral cooperation. During the visit, agreements were signed across several sectors. The trip also aims to secure trade routes through Egypt and Central Asia, potentially bypassing Western tariffs and regulations. This visit signifies China's growing engagement in the Middle East and its efforts to expand its global economic and political reach.
